extraction.notes: Q4 2022 three-month column taken from Table 2 (page seq 13, printed 10); the same table repeats on seq 45 (printed 26), not used. Starts from net income attributable to common stockholders. No AFFO metric is reported, so affo fields are null. Share count 140,007,823 converted to thousands (140,007.823); it reproduces $2.57 FFO and $2.59 Core FFO per share. Ambiguous categorization: 'Gain on other real estate transactions, net' (4,944) classed as 'other' because the filing does not say whether it is land or depreciable real estate. Zero-value lines (Casualty loss, JV promote, Loss on extinguishment) are shown as '—' in the Q4 2022 column. Subtotals verified: FFO 359,135 and Core FFO 363,087 both foot.
